11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager content with an ordinary life puzzles a friend who has several ambitious plans.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has no particular desire to become famous, wealthy, powerful, or exceptionally accomplished. (subject.He/She) enjoys (subject.his/her) work, appreciates (subject.his/her) friends, and hopes to spend many more evenings watching the sunset. (friend), who has several ambitious plans, finds this difficult to understand.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I like my life," says (subject). "Don't you want more?" asks (friend). "Sometimes. But not necessarily more of everything." (friend) thinks about this. They watch the sunset together.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) enthusiastically describes plans to master three professions, explore the island, and write a scholarly monograph. (subject) listens with genuine interest. "That sounds wonderful for you," (subject.he/she) says. Neither feels compelled to adopt the other's goals.
